claim: The Phase-I engineering baseline in ENGINEERING.md is the one this repository actually runs on, and it holds under its own checks.

visible_result.shows: every repository check running on exactly the baseline the document declares: Python 3.11+, standard library only, SQLite and a filesystem content-addressed store, JSON Schema at machine boundaries, unittest
visible_result.expect: PASS, inside the three-second budget, with no third-party import anywhere in the run

evidence.says: the baseline as written: two Systems of Record, the minimal reference stack, kernel primitives, and the growth triggers that would force a dependency
thirteen checks, each a separate process, none importing a third-party package
enforces the style half of the baseline against working-tree bytes: line endings, module size, secret shapes

why_it_matters: Every later choice inherits this. While it sat as an open question, no agent could say whether adding a dependency was a decision or a defect, so both answers stayed available and the argument reran on every branch.
what_could_defeat_it: A required Phase-I behaviour that the standard library genuinely cannot express, which would make the dependency-free rule a fiction rather than a constraint.
A verify run that passes on a machine with packages installed and fails on a clean one, which would mean the checks never actually tested the baseline.
SQLite proving unable to hold the append-preserving record without a second store, which would move the storage claim from mechanism to semantics.
residuals: services/asset/src/soveraeign_asset_service/core.py is 341 lines against the 300-line limit, recorded as named debt in scripts/lint.py rather than silently allowed.
The baseline is self-tested. No independent witness has run it, so ACCEPT here is acceptance of a build claim, not of a witnessed one.
on_accept: STATUS.yaml engineering_framework_status becomes RATIFIED and ENGINEERING.md drops its proposal framing; the O2 ruling in STATUS.yaml rulings is deleted as spent.
on_reject: ENGINEERING.md stays proposed, the O2 ruling stands as the working default, and the rejection reason names which of the three defeaters landed.
